decisions.reason: As a core Christmas pyramid close to established craft capabilities, it should be kept unless several seasons have clearly shown weak demand, and its carrying cost is likely modest.
Because it is an accessory tied to the discontinued electronic music box, uncertainty has largely resolved negatively and the remaining upside no longer justifies keeping this option open.
This seasonal add-on depends even more on the abandoned music-box platform, so management would likely release resources rather than continue a peripheral orphan product.
It builds on the firm's proven pyramid tradition and distinctive craftsmanship, so despite some niche risk from its specific theme it still merits staying on the market.
